translations.web: But of that day or that hour no one knows, not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.
translations.bsb: No one knows about that day or hour, not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.
translations.kjv: But of that day and that hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels which are in heaven, neither the Son, but the Father.
translations.asv: But of that day or that hour knoweth no one, not even the angels in heaven, neither the Son, but the Father.
